---
title: "MCQPy Web"
filters:
  - shinylive
---

This page embeds the MCQPy Shinylive quiz app using a generated wheel-based include.

The include is produced with `mcqpy_shiny.embed_cli`, which emits a small Shinylive app
wrapper plus a `requirements.txt` that installs `mcqpy-shiny` from a published wheel.

The preview site is published under `/shiny/`, while the wheel artifacts are published under
`/wheels/` on the same Pages deployment.

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true
## file: app.py
from mcqpy_shiny.embed_app import create_app

app = create_app(
    fixed_url=None,
    fixed_token=None,
    allow_manual_load=True,
    title='MCQPy Quiz',
    card_width='900px',
)
## file: requirements.txt
shiny>=1.2.1
https://au-mbg.github.io/mcqpy/wheels/mcqpy_core-0.1.1-py3-none-any.whl
https://au-mbg.github.io/mcqpy/wheels/mcqpy_shiny-0.1.1-py3-none-any.whl
```
